    • Method Detail

      • ssTableSizeInMB

        public TableOptions.CompactionOptions.LeveledCompactionStrategyOptions ssTableSizeInMB​(Integer ssTableSizeInMB)
        The target size for SSTables that use the leveled compaction strategy. Although SSTable sizes should be less or equal to sstable_size_in_mb, it is possible to have a larger SSTable during compaction. This occurs when data for a given partition key is exceptionally large. The data is not split into two SSTables

        If no call is made to this method, the default value set by Cassandra is 160.

        Parameters:
        ssTableSizeInMB - the new value.
        Returns:
        this object (for call chaining).
